ParcelPanel's JCEX page offered it to try. JCEX's tracker answers it as a parcel from China handed to Colissimo in France.

Made-up number in the shape of a parcel a reader looked up: JCZ, ten digits and IN, which JCEX's tracker answered as the waybill and order number of a shipment sent by sea to the United States. No public page shows a whole number in this shape. Its serial sits far beyond the range in use.
